limits: Two repeatedly fitted visits, not generalization or biological-state recovery.
Changes in CE weighting can alter both gradient direction and scale; gradient summaries do not isolate every optimization mechanism.
Half-weighted loss gradients are not a decomposition of AdamW updates.
Original-condition reruns may differ from historical readiness because CUDA training is nondeterministic.
Diagnostic fits are not replacement readiness seeds or R66 acceptance evidence.
